translations.TL: %s, di mo kailangang magbahagi, pero maraming salamat talaga.

translations.EN: %s, thanks! It's rare to find such kindness out here.
translations.TL: %s, salamat! Bihira ang ganitong kabaitan dito.

translations.EN: %s, warm thanks. We always take care of our own.
translations.TL: %s, taos-pusong pasasalamat. Inaalagaan natin ang kasama.

translations.EN: %s, that touches my heart. Thank you, partner.
translations.TL: %s, tumatagos sa puso ko 'yan. Salamat, kasama.

translations.EN: %s, you're a lifesaver. I appreciate you.
translations.TL: %s, tagapagligtas ka. Salamat sa 'yo.

translations.EN: %s, thanks a million! I'll return the favor.
translations.TL: %s, milyong salamat! Babalikan ko ang pabor na 'to.

translations.EN: No thanks. I can handle it.
translations.TL: Hindi salamat. Kaya ko na.

translations.EN: I don't need hand-outs. Thanks anyway.
translations.TL: Di ko kailangan ng limos. Salamat pa rin.

translations.EN: Keep your supplies. You'll need them more than me.
translations.TL: Itago mo ang gamit mo. Mas kailangan mo 'yan kaysa sa akin.

translations.EN: I prefer to rely on myself, but thanks.
translations.TL: Mas gusto kong umasa sa sarili ko, pero salamat.

translations.EN: No thank you. What's the catch?
translations.TL: Hindi salamat. May kapalit ba 'yan?

translations.EN: I'm managing fine on my own.
translations.TL: Maayos ang pamamahala ko sa sarili ko.

translations.EN: Pass. I carry what I need.
translations.TL: Tatanggihan ko. Dala ko ang kailangan ko.

translations.EN: Thanks, but no. Save it.
translations.TL: Salamat, pero hindi. Itabi mo.

translations.EN: I'll take care of my own needs.
translations.TL: Ako na ang bahala sa mga pangangailangan ko.

translations.EN: Not interested, but thanks for offering.
translations.TL: Di ako interesado, pero salamat sa pag-alok.

translations.EN: Thanks. I'll keep that in mind.
translations.TL: Salamat. Tatandaan ko iyan.

translations.EN: Thank you for the offer.
translations.TL: Salamat sa alok mo.

translations.EN: I appreciate you offering. I'll let you know.
translations.TL: Salamat sa pag-alok. Sasabihan kita.

translations.EN: Good to know. I might take you up on that.
translations.TL: Mabuting malaman. Baka tanggapin ko 'yan.

translations.EN: Thanks. That's a helpful gesture.
translations.TL: Salamat. Nakatutulong ang malasakit mo.

translations.EN: I'll consider it. Thanks.
translations.TL: Isasaalang-alang ko. Salamat.

translations.EN: Much obliged for the thought.
translations.TL: Maraming salamat sa magandang kaisipan.

translations.EN: Appreciate the option. Thank you.
translations.TL: Salamat sa pagbibigay ng opsyon.

translations.EN: Thanks. We'll see how the day goes.
translations.TL: Salamat. Tingnan natin ang takbo ng araw.

translations.EN: Kind offer. Thank you.
translations.TL: Mabuting alok. Salamat.

translations.EN: Thanks.
translations.TL: Salamat.

translations.EN: I'm good.
translations.TL: Ayos ako.

translations.EN: Keep it.
translations.TL: Itabi mo.

translations.EN: Pass.
translations.TL: Tanggi muna.

translations.EN: Noted.
translations.TL: Tala ko na.

translations.EN: Appreciated.
translations.TL: Pinahahalagahan.

translations.EN: Got it.
translations.TL: Nakuha ko.

translations.EN: No thanks.
translations.TL: Hindi salamat.

translations.EN: Maybe later.
translations.TL: Baka mamaya.

translations.EN: Thank you.
translations.TL: Salamat sa 'yo.

translations.EN: Thank you, I appreciate the offer.
translations.TL: Salamat, pinahahalagahan ko ang alok mo.

translations.EN: That is so kind of you! Thank you so much.
translations.TL: Napakabait mo naman! Maraming-maraming salamat.

translations.EN: I'm grateful for that. You're a true friend.
translations.TL: Nagpapasalamat ako riyan. Tunay kang kaibigan.

translations.EN: That makes life a little easier out here. Thanks!
translations.TL: Gumagaan ang buhay rito dahil diyan. Salamat!

translations.EN: Always generous. Thank you, partner.
translations.TL: Laging bukas-palad. Salamat, kasama.

translations.EN: Thank you! I won't forget your kindness.
translations.TL: Salamat! Hindi ko malilimutan ang kabaitan mo.

translations.EN: You didn't have to, but thank you from the bottom of my heart.
translations.TL: Hindi mo naman kailangang gawin, pero salamat mula sa puso.

translations.EN: That's wonderful of you. Thank you!
translations.TL: Napakaganda ng ginawa mo. Salamat!

translations.EN: Appreciate you so much. Let me return the favor soon.
translations.TL: Salamat nang marami. Hayaan mong masuklian ko 'to agad.

translations.EN: Thank you, friend. We look after one another.
translations.TL: Salamat, kaibigan. Nag-aalagaan tayo rito.

translations.EN: Back away. Now.
translations.TL: Umatras ka. Ngayon.

translations.EN: Take one more step and find out.
translations.TL: Humakbang ka pa nang isa at nang malaman mo.

translations.EN: Keep your hands off your weapon and step back.
translations.TL: Alisin ang kamay sa armas at umatras ka.

translations.EN: You're threatening the wrong survivor.
translations.TL: Maling tao ang tinatakot mo.

translations.EN: Back up before I put you down.
translations.TL: Umatras ka bago kita patumbahin.

translations.EN: I am not afraid to defend myself. Back off.
translations.TL: Hindi ako natatakot ipagtanggol ang sarili ko. Lumayo ka.

translations.EN: Last chance to walk away alive.
translations.TL: Huling pagkakataon para lumakad palayo nang buhay.

translations.EN: You don't want this fight. Step back.
translations.TL: Ayaw mo sa laban na ito. Umatras ka.

translations.EN: Back away immediately.
translations.TL: Lumayo ka agad-agad.

translations.EN: Hands where I can see them. Back off.
translations.TL: Kamay kung saan ko nakikita. Umatras ka.

translations.EN: Step back or we have a problem.
translations.TL: Umatras ka o magkakaproblema tayo.

translations.EN: You need to back off right now.
translations.TL: Kailangan mong lumayo ngayon din.

translations.EN: Keep your distance. Don't make this turn ugly.
translations.TL: Panatilihin ang distansya. Huwag mong gawing madugo ito.

translations.EN: I'm giving you fair warning: stand down.
translations.TL: Binibigyan kita ng patas na babala: ibaba ang armas.

translations.EN: Back away. Neither of us needs this fight.
translations.TL: Umatras ka. Walang nangangailangan ng laban na 'to.

translations.EN: Step down. Let's not do something stupid.
translations.TL: Huminahon ka. Huwag tayong gumawa ng katangahan.

translations.EN: I won't hesitate if you keep advancing.
translations.TL: Hindi ako magdadalawang-isip kapag lumapit ka pa.

translations.EN: Hold your ground right there. Do not advance.
translations.TL: Diyan ka lang. Huwag kang susulong.

translations.EN: Lower your weapon and step back.
translations.TL: Ibaba mo ang armas mo at umatras.

translations.EN: This is your only warning. Back off.
translations.TL: Ito na ang nag-iisang babala mo. Umatras ka.

translations.EN: Back off.
translations.TL: Umatras ka.

translations.EN: Step back.
translations.TL: Lumayo ka.

translations.EN: Stand down.
translations.TL: Ibaba ang armas.

translations.EN: Don't.
translations.TL: Huwag.

translations.EN: Back away.
translations.TL: Lumayo ka.

translations.EN: Hands up.
translations.TL: Itaas ang kamay.

translations.EN: Stop.
translations.TL: Tigil.

translations.EN: Freeze.
translations.TL: Huwag gagalaw.

translations.EN: Last warning.
translations.TL: Huling babala.

translations.EN: Drop it.
translations.TL: Ibaba mo 'yan.

translations.EN: Hey, please, don't do this. Step back.
translations.TL: Huy, pakiusap, huwag mong gawin 'to. Umatras ka.

translations.EN: We don't need blood spilled today. Put it down.
translations.TL: Di natin kailangang magpadanak ng dugo ngayon. Ibaba mo 'yan.

translations.EN: Listen to reason, friend. Step away before someone gets hurt.
translations.TL: Makinig ka sa katwiran, kaibigan. Lumayo ka bago may masaktan.

translations.EN: I don't want to hurt you. Please, back off.
translations.TL: Ayaw kitang saktan. Pakiusap, umatras ka.

translations.EN: Don't throw your life away over this. Stand down.
translations.TL: Huwag mong itapon ang buhay mo dahil dito. Ibaba ang armas.

translations.EN: We can still walk away peacefully. Step back.
translations.TL: Maaari pa tayong lumayo nang payapa. Umatras ka.

translations.EN: Take a breath and think about what you're doing. Back up.
translations.TL: Huminga ka muna at isipin ang ginagawa mo. Umatras ka.

translations.EN: I value your life, but I will protect mine. Please stop.
translations.TL: Mahalaga ang buhay mo, pero poprotektahan ko ang akin. Pakiusap tigil.

translations.EN: Don't make me do something we'll both regret. Step back.
translations.TL: Huwag mo akong piliting gumawa ng pagsisisihan natin. Umatras ka.

translations.EN: We're both survivors. Let's keep it that way. Back down.
translations.TL: Pareho tayong nakaligtas. Panatilihin nating ganoon. Huminahon ka.
